description: Gefahrenzonenplan der Bundeswasserbauverwaltung - Rotgelber Funktionsbereich is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service.stmk.gv.at. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard Zone Plan of the Federal Water Works Administration - Red Yellow Functional Area" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
